title: Family organiser app
summary: One app to coordinate family schedules.
whyItFails: Shared calendars exist. Google and Apple. Adoption. All members must use it. Low willingness to pay. Free alternatives.
whatWouldChange: AI that pulls schedules from school emails automatically.

attempts.notes: Family calendar and lists; owned by Time Inc. from 2014, then Meredith, then OurFamilyWizard from 2022.
